newsitem.title: CANADA: NrG signs deals to link natural gas systems.
newsitem.headline: NrG signs deals to link natural gas systems.

text.p: NrG Information Services Inc, which develops and markets the NrG Highway gas pipeline booking software, said on Wednesday it signed agreements with six North American gas management system providers to offer a seamless service between gas transportation and gas management systems.

NrG, owned by TransCanada PipeLines Ltd, NOVA Corp and Westcoast Energy Inc, said the deal would mean an end to the need for large information systems development often required make gas transport and management systems mesh.
NrG Highway is a standardized computer software that allows customers to book space on several North American gas pipelines.

The providers of gas management systems agreeing to work toward meshing their systems with NrG included Allegro Development, EMSC Marketing Systems, Tenneco Inc unit Energy Tracs, Marwell Information Systems Inc, Tragoes and TransEnergy.
"With this announcement, we're one step closer to integrating the entire gas business," NrG president Nancy Laird said in a statement.
